faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AffProf.

items.q: How is AffProf different from a typical link shortener?
items.a: AffProf does more than shorten. It monitors your links for breakage, redirects traffic to a backup when something fails, organizes links by product and campaign, generates branded QR codes, and shows you which channels are actually driving clicks. Generic shorteners don't do any of that.

items.q: What happens when one of my links breaks?
items.a: AffProf detects it automatically and alerts you by email. On Pro, your traffic gets redirected to a fallback URL so visitors don't land on a dead page while you fix it.

items.q: How often are my links checked?
items.a: On Free, links are checked once per day. On Pro, they're checked 4 times per day, so a broken link is detected within hours instead of a full day.

items.q: Do I need to change my existing links?
items.a: No. You keep your original URLs. AffProf wraps them with a short link, tracks every click, and monitors them in the background — without touching your existing setup.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes, on Pro. Connect a custom subdomain so your links look like links.yourbrand.com/product instead of a generic shortener URL.

items.q: Does AffProf work with affiliate links from Amazon, ShareASale, Impact, etc.?
items.a: Yes — and any other URL too. Amazon Associates, ShareASale, Impact, CJ Affiliate, Rakuten, ClickBank, Hotmart, your own product pages, your own course landing pages, your booking link, your portfolio. If you can paste a URL, AffProf can manage it.

Creators sharing links to videos, courses, and recommendations. Coaches and consultants sharing booking and portfolio links. Marketers and agencies tracking client campaigns. Affiliate sites monitoring hundreds of links. Small businesses sharing QR codes on flyers, packaging, and print. Anyone who shares the same link in many places and wants to know what happens to it.

items.q: Can I import my existing links?
items.a: Yes, on Pro. Upload a CSV with your current links and AffProf imports everything in seconds. No need to recreate your library by hand.

items.q: Do you collect personal data from people who click my links?
items.a: No. AffProf records aggregate analytics only — country, device, browser, referrer — never personal identifiers. Your audience stays anonymous.
Yes. Cancel anytime from your account settings. If you cancel Pro, you keep using AffProf on the Free plan with your existing links intact.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. The Free plan is genuinely free and you can use it as long as you want. You only enter payment info when you decide to upgrade to Pro.

items.q: Can I use AffProf with Amazon Associates or programs that prohibit cloaking?
items.a: Yes. AffProf uses standard 302 redirects, not cloaking. This is permitted by most affiliate programs including Amazon Associates' standard terms. Always check your specific program's terms to be sure.
